name: Luck points
author: Alexandria
summary: Each player has a few luck points to reroll a d20 they don't like; they come back each session.

effect.chat: {name} spends a luck point to reroll ({note})

rules.text: Each player has **luck points** (3 by default). Spend one **after seeing a d20 roll** to roll again and take either result. They refill at the start of each session.

assistant.gm: Players have luck points that refill each session. A player spends one after a d20 roll to reroll and keep either result.
assistant.player: You have luck points that refill each session: spend one after a bad d20 roll to reroll it and keep either result. Type /luck in chat.
